scenarios.title: A prowl spell may be cast for its prowl cost only after a matching creature dealt combat damage to a player
decisions: A attacks player B with Triton Shorethief.
Combat damage is dealt; Triton Shorethief deals 1 damage to B.
In the second main phase, evaluate whether A may cast Latchkey Faerie for its prowl cost {2}{U}, with three untapped Islands.

variants.label: rogue_connected
variants.expected: Triton Shorethief, a Rogue under A's control, dealt combat damage to B this turn. Casting Latchkey Faerie for {2}{U} is legal (can_play true); the mana cost {3}{U} cannot be paid with three Islands.

variants.label: rogue_blocked
variants.delta: B blocks Triton Shorethief with Grizzly Bears.
variants.expected: No player was dealt combat damage this turn. Casting Latchkey Faerie is not legal (can_play false).

variants.label: wrong_type
variants.delta: A attacks with Goblin Piker instead of Triton Shorethief and B declares no blockers.
variants.expected: B was dealt combat damage (life 18), but Goblin Piker is neither a Faerie nor a Rogue. Casting Latchkey Faerie is not legal (can_play false).
